Public domain: every person whose words are in this text died in 1925 or earlier, so the term has ended under the law of every country, whichever one first published it.

People: Tom Hood (author, Wikidata Q1270673), died 1874; Gustave Doré (illustrator, Wikidata Q6682), died 1883. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Hood, Tom, 1835-1874; Doré, Gustave, 1832-1883 [Illustrator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Fairy realm. A collection of the favourite old tales. Illustrated by the pencil of Gustave Doré, London : Ward, Lock and Tyler, 1866, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/fairyrealm00hoodrich. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 89%, 94%, 100% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Gustave Doré, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
